# hivelocity_vlan (Data Source)

Looks up one of your VLANs, for example by `vlan_tag` or `facility_code`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_vlan" "private" {
  filter {
    name   = "vlan_tag"
    values = ["1234"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter the results. Every filter block must match (logical AND); a block matches when the attribute named by `name` equals any of `values`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `first` (Boolean) When true (the default) return the first match instead of erroring when more than one item matches the filters.

### Read-Only

- `automated` (Boolean) True when the VLAN can be automated via the API.
- `facility_code` (String) Facility of the VLAN.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_ids` (List of Number) IP assignments routed to the VLAN.
- `port_ids` (List of Number) Ports and bonds in the VLAN.
- `q_in_q` (Boolean) True when the VLAN is in Q-in-Q mode.
- `type` (String) `private` or `public`.
- `vlan_id` (Number) Unique ID of the VLAN.
- `vlan_tag` (Number) VLAN tag on the switch.

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) Attribute name to filter on
- `values` (List of String) Accepted values for the attribute
